data: Replogle et al., Cell 2022, doi 10.1016/j.cell.2022.05.013; figshare 20029387; CC BY 4.0
caveats: Same sgRNA library elements in all three screens: reproduction is across cells, days and sequencing, not across reagents; guide off-target effects would reproduce.
Steady state (day 6 and day 8): direct and indirect effects are mixed.

SPECIFIC = beyond the tide and 5 cell-wide axes learnt from other knockdowns. It still contains programmes shared by members of a complex or pathway, and removes the defining effects of regulators that drive a shared axis.
Cis zone: self + genes with a TSS within 100 kb were zeroed; trans effects of a co-silenced promoter partner (e.g. head-to-head genes) are attributed to the targeted protein.
paralog_flag is a heuristic (shared HGNC family + symbol prefix), not sequence paralogy.
FDR is a sign-flip estimate (opposite-sign co-hits / same-sign co-hits).
